articles.title: U.S. Navy Advances New W93 Nuclear Warhead for Trident Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missiles
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy's W93 warhead and Mk7 reentry body, destined for the Trident II Submarine Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) under the D5 Life Extension 2 program, have entered development. This initiative aims to modernize the U.S. nuclear deterrent, ensuring its continued reliability and capability. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the ongoing focus on strategic defence modernization and maintaining a robust nuclear triad.
